test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the capital of Maldives, a neighboring country of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Male**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maldives **is an island nation located in the Indian Ocean, southwest of India.
 
• It is Asia's second least populous country, with 515,132 people according to the 2022 census.
 
• Considered the "King's Island" due to its central location,** Malé** is the capital and most populous city of the region.
 
• The country is composed of 26 atolls, which are made up of more than 1,000 coral islands.
 
• Maldives is known for its beautiful beaches, crystal-clear waters, and diverse marine life, making it a popular tourist destination.
 
• The economy of Maldives is heavily dependent on tourism, which accounts for about a third of its GDP.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kavaratti: This is the capital of Lakshadweep, a group of islands located off the coast of India. It is not the capital of Maldives.
 
• Colombo: This is the capital of Sri Lanka, another neighboring country of India. It is not the capital of Maldives.
 
• Abu Dhabi: This is the capital of the United Arab Emirates, which is located in the Middle East. It is not the capital of Maldives.
